Dear [Hiring Manager's Name],  

I’ve had the privilege of working closely with Uma Krishnan over the past year as a professor at [Academic Institution], where she served as a senior tech lead at NexaCorp. Her role bridged academic research and enterprise engineering, and her contributions were both impactful and consistent.  

Uma’s strengths lie in her ability to translate complex technical challenges into scalable solutions. She led the redesign of NexaCorp’s monolithic architecture, splitting it into microservices that improved system reliability by 40% during peak loads. Her system design decisions prioritized long-term maintainability, which became a reference point for junior engineers. She also spearheaded a cross-team Agile transformation, reducing delivery cycles by 25% through optimized sprint planning and stakeholder alignment.  

A standout example of her leadership occurred during a critical database migration. When a legacy system’s performance bottleneck threatened project timelines, Uma coordinated with DevOps, QA, and business stakeholders to refactor query patterns and implement indexing strategies. The result was a 60% reduction in latency, with minimal downtime. Her ability to communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders ensured alignment across teams.  

Beyond her technical expertise, Uma’s work ethic is unwavering. She consistently mentors junior engineers, often staying late to review code or troubleshoot production issues. Her combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution makes her a rare asset in any team.  

I’m confident she’ll bring the same level of rigor and collaboration to your organization. Please feel free to reach out for further details.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Academic Institution]
